_about: Voiceover scripts per exercise slug. `intro` plays once when voice guidance is switched on; `cues` play on every rep at `at` seconds into the clip's loop. Cue times follow the phase timings in scripts/exercise-3d/blender/rh_exercises.py (30 fps). {side} becomes 'left' or 'right' for sided exercises. Keep cue phrases short enough to finish before the next cue.

mini-squat.intro: This is a mini squat. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out in front for balance. Push your hips back and bend your knees about a quarter of the way down, keeping your chest up and your knees in line with your toes. Hold for a moment, then push through your heels to stand tall. Follow along with me.

sit-to-stand.intro: This is sit to stand. Sit near the front of a firm chair with your feet flat, slightly behind your knees. Lean forward so your nose comes over your toes, then push through both feet to stand up tall. To sit, reach your hips back and lower yourself slowly, with control. Follow along with me.

calf-raise.intro: This is a calf raise. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a counter or a wall lightly for balance. Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, hold for a moment, then lower your heels slowly. Take your time on the way down. Follow along with me.

seated-knee-extension.intro: This is a seated knee extension for your {side} leg. Sit tall at the back of a chair. Straighten your {side} knee until your leg is out straight, then pull your toes up towards you and hold. Lower your foot slowly back to the floor. Keep your thigh resting on the chair. Follow along with me.

glute-bridge.intro: This is a glute bridge. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip-width apart. Tighten your stomach, squeeze your buttocks, and lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees are in one line. Hold, then lower slowly. Don't arch your lower back. Follow along with me.

straight-leg-raise.intro: This is a straight leg raise for your {side} leg. Lie on your back and bend your other knee, keeping that foot flat. Tighten the thigh of your {side} leg and pull your toes up. Lift the straight leg to the height of your bent knee, hold, then lower it slowly. Keep the knee completely straight. Follow along with me.

heel-slides.intro: These are heel slides for your {side} knee. Lie on your back with your legs straight. Slowly slide your {side} heel towards your buttock, bending your knee as far as is comfortable. Then slide it back out until your leg is straight. Keep your heel on the mat the whole time. Follow along with me.

calf-stretch.intro: This is a calf stretch at a wall, for your {side} calf. Put your hands on the wall and step your {side} leg back, toes pointing forward and the heel flat on the floor. Keeping the back knee straight, bend your front knee and lean your hips towards the wall until you feel a stretch in the upper calf, and hold. Then ease off, bend the back knee slightly with the heel still down, and feel the stretch lower in the calf. Follow along with me.

plantar-fascia-wall-stretch.intro: This is a plantar fascia stretch for your {side} foot. Stand facing a wall with your hands on it. Put the toes of your {side} foot up against the wall, with the heel and the ball of the foot on the floor. Keeping your heel down, bend that knee towards the wall until you feel a stretch under your foot, and hold. Then ease back. Follow along with me.

quad-stretch.intro: This is a standing thigh stretch for your {side} leg. Hold the back of a chair with one hand. Bend your {side} knee and take hold of your ankle behind you. Gently draw your heel towards your buttock, with your knees together and your body upright, until you feel a stretch at the front of the thigh. Hold, then let go and lower your foot slowly. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Bend your knee, hold your ankle.

single-leg-balance.intro: This is single-leg balance on your {side} leg. Stand close to a chair or counter, so you can hold on if you need to. Shift your weight onto your {side} leg, lift the other foot off the floor, and balance, standing tall. Small wobbles are normal. Then put your foot down. Follow along with me.

wall-sit.intro: This is a wall sit. Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about a step out in front of you, hip-width apart. Slide down the wall until your knees are bent, as far as is comfortable, keeping your knees over your feet and your back flat on the wall. Hold the position, breathing normally, then slide back up. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Hold. Back flat on the wall.

wall-squat.intro: This is a wall squat. Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about a step out in front of you, hip-width apart. Slide down the wall by bending your knees, as far as you can control, keeping your knees in line with your toes. Then push through your heels to slide back up. Follow along with me.

seated-hamstring-stretch.intro: This is a seated hamstring stretch for your {side} leg. Sit near the front of a firm chair and straighten your {side} leg out in front of you, heel on the floor and toes pointing up. Sit tall, then lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight, until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Hold, then sit back up. Follow along with me.

seated-calf-hold.intro: This is a seated calf hold. Sit on a firm chair with your feet flat and your hands on your thighs. Press down through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as you can, and hold them up, pressing down on your thighs to add load. Then lower your heels slowly. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Hold. Press down on your thighs.

seated-static-quads.intro: This is a static thigh push for your {side} knee. Sit on a firm chair. Straighten your {side} leg part way, then cross your other ankle in front of it. Push your {side} leg forwards, as if straightening the knee, while the other leg pushes back, so neither one moves. Hold, breathing normally, then relax and lower both feet. Follow along with me.

calf-towel-stretch.intro: This is a calf stretch with a towel, for your {side} leg. Sit with your legs out straight and loop a towel around the ball of your {side} foot, holding both ends. Keeping your knee straight, pull the towel to draw your toes and foot towards you, until you feel a stretch in your calf. Hold, then ease off. Follow along with me.

plantar-fascia-towel-stretch.intro: This is a plantar fascia towel stretch for your {side} foot. Sit with your legs out straight and loop a towel around the toes of your {side} foot, holding both ends. Pull the towel to bend your toes and foot back towards you, until you feel a stretch under your foot. Hold, then ease off. It helps to do this before your first steps in the morning. Follow along with me.

static-push-down.intro: This is a static push down for your {side} ankle. Sit with your legs out straight, with a towel looped around the ball of your {side} foot and held taut. Push your foot down into the towel, as if pressing a pedal, while your hands hold the towel still, so the ankle doesn't move. Hold, then relax. Push only as hard as is comfortable. Follow along with me.

ankle-circles.intro: These are ankle circles for your {side} ankle. Sit with your legs out straight and a rolled towel under your lower calf, so your heel is off the floor. Keeping your leg still, slowly draw circles with your foot, moving only at the ankle. Make the circles as big as is comfortable, then change direction. Follow along with me.

hamstring-doorway-stretch.intro: This is a hamstring stretch in a doorway, for your {side} leg. Lie on your back in a doorway. Rest your {side} leg up the wall beside the door frame, with your other leg lying straight through the doorway. Straighten the raised knee, sliding your heel up the wall, until you feel a stretch behind your thigh. Hold, then bend the knee again. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Straighten your knee up the wall.

eccentric-heel-drop.intro: This is an eccentric heel drop for your {side} leg. Stand on the balls of both feet on a step, with your heels over the edge, holding a wall or rail. Rise up on both feet. Take your other foot off the step, then lower your {side} heel slowly below the step, taking about three seconds, with your knee straight. Put the other foot back, and use both feet to rise up again. Follow along with me.

plantar-fascia-loading.intro: This is plantar fascia loading for your {side} foot. Stand with the toes of your {side} foot on a rolled towel, holding a wall, and lift your other foot off the floor. Rise up onto your toes slowly, over three seconds, hold for two seconds, then lower slowly over three seconds. Follow along with me.

forward-step-up.intro: This is a forward step-up, leading with your {side} leg. Stand facing a step, with a rail or wall nearby. Step up with your {side} leg, placing your whole foot on the step, then push through that heel to straighten your knee and bring the other foot up. Step down with the other leg first, lowering yourself slowly, then bring your {side} foot down. Follow along with me.

single-leg-decline-squat.intro: This is a single-leg decline squat on your {side} leg. Stand on your {side} leg on a decline board, toes pointing down the slope, and hold your other leg off the board. Squat down slowly, taking about three seconds, until your knee is bent about sixty degrees, keeping your knee over your toes and your body upright. Then stand back up. Follow along with me.

heel-to-toe-walking.intro: This is heel-to-toe walking. Stand beside a wall or counter you can reach. Walk forwards in a straight line, placing the heel of each foot right in front of the toes of the other. Keep your eyes looking ahead and your arms out for balance. Take about ten steps, then turn and come back. Follow along with me.

standing-hip-abduction.intro: This is standing hip abduction for your {side} leg. Stand tall, holding a chair or counter for support, with your toes pointing forward. Lift your {side} leg out to the side a small amount, without leaning your body, hold for a moment, then lower it slowly back to the start. Follow along with me.

shoulder-flexion.intro: This is shoulder flexion. Stand tall with your arms by your sides and your thumbs pointing forward. Keeping your elbows straight, raise both arms forward and up as high as is comfortable, hold for a moment, then lower them slowly. Don't shrug your shoulders. Follow along with me.

chin-tuck.intro: This is a chin tuck. Sit or stand tall, looking straight ahead. Gently glide your head straight back, as if making a double chin, keeping your eyes level. Hold for a few seconds, then relax back to the start. Follow along with me.

wall-push-up.intro: This is a wall push-up. Stand facing a wall, a little more than arm's length away, with your hands on the wall at shoulder height. Keeping your body straight, bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall, then push back to the start. Follow along with me.

clamshell.intro: This is a clamshell for your {side} hip. Lie on your side with your knees bent and your feet together, and your head resting on a pillow. Keeping your feet touching and your pelvis still, lift your top knee like a clam opening, hold for a moment, then lower it slowly. Follow along with me.

cat-camel.intro: This is the cat camel. Get onto your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Slowly round your back up towards the ceiling, tucking your chin and tail. Then let your back gently dip, lifting your head and tail. Move slowly and within comfort. Follow along with me.

bird-dog.intro: This is the bird dog, reaching with your {side} arm. Get onto your hands and knees and tighten your stomach muscles. Reach your {side} arm forward and the opposite leg back, until both are level with your body. Hold without twisting, then return. Follow along with me.

static-quads.intro: This is static thigh tightening for your {side} knee. Sit with your legs out straight and a small rolled towel under your {side} knee. Tighten the muscle at the front of your thigh to press the back of your knee down into the towel, and pull your toes up towards you. Hold, breathing normally, then relax completely. Follow along with me.

knee-rolling.intro: This is knee rolling. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Slowly let both knees roll to one side, keeping your shoulders on the floor. Bring them back to the middle, then roll them to the other side. Keep it gentle and rhythmic. Follow along with me.

pelvic-rocking.intro: This is pelvic rocking. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Gently flatten your lower back into the floor by tilting your pelvis, then gently arch your lower back a little. Rock slowly between the two. Follow along with me.

sitting-pelvic-rocking.intro: This is sitting pelvic rocking. Sit on a firm chair with your feet flat. Slowly roll your pelvis back so your lower back slumps a little, then roll forwards so you sit tall with a small arch. Repeat slowly. Follow along with me.

forward-bend-sitting.intro: This is a forward bend in sitting. Sit on a chair with your feet apart. Slowly bend forwards, letting your hands slide down towards the floor. Hold, then slowly sit back up. Follow along with me.

childs-pose.intro: This is the child's pose stretch. Kneel on the floor on your hands and knees. Sit back towards your heels, walking your hands forwards on the floor. Let your head relax down and breathe slowly, feeling a gentle stretch in your back. Hold, then come back up. Follow along with me.

sciatic-nerve-glide.intro: This is a sciatic nerve glide for your {side} leg. Sit on a chair, slumped slightly. Straighten your {side} knee while you look up, then bend the knee again as you look down. Keep the movement smooth and rhythmic, and don't hold the stretch. Follow along with me.

femoral-nerve-glide.intro: This is a femoral nerve glide for your {side} leg. Lie on your side with your {side} leg on top. Hold the top ankle and gently bend the knee while moving the hip back, then release and return. Keep it gentle and rhythmic. Follow along with me.

chair-squat.intro: This is a chair squat. Stand in front of a chair with your feet hip-width apart. Push your hips back and bend your knees until you lightly touch the chair, then stand back up without sitting down. Try not to use your hands. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Hips back, down to the chair.

static-hip-pushout.intro: This is a static hip push-out. Lie on your back with your knees bent and a belt or band around your knees. Press your knees gently outwards into the belt, without moving, and hold. Then relax. Follow along with me.

pelvic-dips.intro: These are pelvic dips on a step, standing on your {side} leg. Stand side-on on the bottom step on your {side} leg, holding the rail if you need to. Keeping your standing knee straight, let your other hip drop down slowly, then lift it back up using the muscles at the side of your standing hip. Follow along with me.

side-lying-hip-lift.intro: This is a side-lying hip lift for your {side} hip. Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent and your {side} leg on top, straight. Lift the top leg up slowly, keeping it slightly behind you with your toes pointing forwards, then lower it slowly. Follow along with me.

buttock-squeeze.intro: This is a buttock squeeze. Lie on your back with your legs straight. Squeeze your buttocks together and hold, breathing normally, then relax fully. Follow along with me.

pendulum-leg-swing.intro: These are pendulum leg swings for your {side} hip. Stand on a step on your other leg, holding a support, and let your {side} leg hang free. Let it swing gently forwards and back. Keep it relaxed, and don't force the movement. Follow along with me.

shoulder-blade-setting.intro: This is shoulder blade setting. Stand or sit tall with your arms relaxed. Gently draw your shoulder blades back and down, as if sliding them into your back pockets. Hold without shrugging, then relax. Follow along with me.

cross-body-stretch.intro: This is a cross-body shoulder stretch for your {side} shoulder. Stand tall and bring your {side} arm across your chest. With your other hand, gently pull it closer at the elbow until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder, and hold. Then release. Follow along with me.

scaption.intro: This is scaption. Stand tall holding a water bottle or light weight in each hand, thumbs up. Lift your arms forwards and slightly out, in a V shape, to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Follow along with me.

assisted-external-rotation.intro: This is assisted outward rotation for your {side} shoulder. Sit tall holding a stick across in front of you, elbows tucked in and bent, palms up. Use your other arm to push the stick so your {side} hand moves outwards, keeping that elbow at your side. Go to a comfortable stretch, then back. Follow along with me.

assisted-abduction.intro: This is an assisted arm lift for your {side} shoulder. Hold a stick in both hands in front of you, palms up. Use your other arm to push your {side} arm out to the side and up, elbow straight, to a comfortable stretch. Then lower slowly. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Push the arm out and up.

static-shoulder-abduction.intro: This is a static shoulder push for your {side} shoulder. Stand side-on to a wall with your {side} elbow bent and touching the wall. Push the elbow gently into the wall without moving, and hold. Then relax. Follow along with me.

static-external-rotation.intro: This is a static outward rotation for your {side} shoulder. Stand side-on to a wall, your {side} elbow bent and tucked into your side. Press the back of your wrist gently out into the wall without moving your arm, and hold. Then relax. Follow along with me.

wall-angels.intro: This is wall angels. Stand with your back against a wall, arms bent in a goalpost shape against it. Slide your arms up the wall as far as is comfortable, then back down, keeping your back and arms close to the wall. Follow along with me.

pendulum.intro: This is the pendulum exercise for your {side} shoulder. Lean forwards with your good hand on a table and let your {side} arm hang down loosely. Gently sway your body so the arm swings in small circles, keeping the shoulder relaxed. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Let the arm swing in small circles.

band-row.intro: This is rowing with a resistance band. Tie the band to a door handle at waist height and hold one end in each hand. Stand tall and pull your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Then slowly return. Follow along with me.

rhomboid-doorway-stretch.intro: This is a rhomboid doorway stretch. Hold onto a door frame with both hands at chest height. Sit your hips back and let your upper back round, so your shoulder blades spread apart. Hold while breathing slowly, then come back up. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Let your upper back round. Hold.

open-book.intro: This is the open book, turning to open your {side} arm. Lie on your side with your knees bent and your arms out in front. Lift your top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes and keeping your knees together. Then return slowly. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Lift and open the top arm.

rolled-towel-extension.intro: This is a rolled towel extension. Lie on your back with your knees bent and a rolled towel across your upper back, under your shoulder blades. Support your head with your hands. Gently let your upper back bend back over the towel, then return. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Let your upper back bend back.

wall-rotation.intro: This is a wall rotation, turning to your {side}. Stand side-on to a wall with your feet a small step away. Turn your upper body towards the wall and place both hands on it, keeping your hips facing forwards. Then turn back. Follow along with me.

doorway-chest-stretch.intro: This is a doorway chest stretch for your {side} side. Stand in a doorway with your {side} forearm on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height, one foot a step forward. Gently shift forwards until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulder and chest, and hold. Then ease back. Follow along with me.

tennis-ball-upper-back.intro: This is tennis ball rolling for your upper back. Place a tennis ball between your upper back and a wall, beside the spine, not on it. Lean into it gently and bend and straighten your knees so it rolls slowly up and down. Pause on any tight spot. Follow along with me.

chin-tuck-lying.intro: This is a chin tuck lying down. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your head on a thin pillow. Gently tuck your chin in, as if making a small double chin, keeping your head on the pillow. Hold while breathing normally, then relax. Follow along with me.

neck-flexion-extension.intro: This is neck bending forwards and backwards. Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed. Slowly nod your chin towards your chest and hold, come back to the middle, then slowly look up towards the ceiling and hold. Move only as far as is comfortable. Follow along with me.

neck-side-bending.intro: This is neck side bending. Sit tall and look straight ahead. Slowly tip your ear towards your shoulder without lifting the shoulder, and hold. Come back to the middle, then go to the other side. Follow along with me.

upper-trap-stretch.intro: This is an upper trapezius stretch for your {side} side. Sit tall and hold the edge of the chair with your {side} hand to keep that shoulder down. Tip your ear away towards the other shoulder, and rest your other hand lightly on your head. Hold, then slowly come back. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Hold the edge of the chair.

neck-band-push-back.intro: This is a neck push-back into a towel. Sit tall, holding a towel around the back of your head with both hands in front. Gently push your head back into it while your hands stop it moving far, chin slightly tucked. Hold, then relax. Follow along with me.

median-nerve-glide.intro: This is a median nerve glide for your {side} arm. Lift your {side} arm out to the side, palm up and elbow bent. Slowly straighten the elbow and bend the wrist back while tipping your head away. Then bend the elbow and tip your head towards the arm. Keep it smooth and never forced. Follow along with me.

tennis-ball-neck.intro: This is a tennis ball self-massage for the top of your {side} shoulder. Stand with your back to a wall, the ball between the wall and the tight muscle. Lean gently into it and roll slowly over the tender spot with small knee bends. Stay on it while breathing slowly. Follow along with me.

static-wrist-extension.intro: This is a static wrist extension for your {side} elbow. Sit with your {side} forearm supported, palm down, the hand over the edge. Place your other hand on the back of the hand and push up into it without moving, and hold. Then relax. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Push up into it. Don't move.

eccentric-wrist-extension.intro: This is the slow lowering wrist exercise for your {side} arm. Rest your {side} forearm palm down, holding a water bottle with the hand over the edge. Use your other hand to help lift the wrist up, then let go and lower slowly on your own. Follow along with me.

cues.text: Now lower slowly, on your own.

wrist-flexor-curl.intro: This is a palm-up wrist curl for your {side} arm. Rest your {side} forearm with the palm up and the hand over the edge, holding a water bottle. Slowly curl the wrist up, then lower slowly, keeping the elbow still. Follow along with me.

wrist-flexor-stretch.intro: This is a palm-up wrist and forearm stretch for your {side} arm. Straighten your {side} arm in front of you, palm up. With your other hand, gently pull the fingers back and down until you feel a stretch in the forearm, and hold. Then release. Follow along with me.

towel-twist.intro: This is a towel twist. Hold a rolled towel in both hands in front of you. Twist it as if wringing out water, one way and then the other, slowly and with control. Follow along with me.

wrist-range-of-movement.intro: These are wrist range of movement exercises for your {side} wrist. Rest your {side} forearm with the hand over the edge. Gently bend the wrist up and down, then side to side. Turn the palm up and down. Then make a full fist and straighten the fingers. Follow along with me.

finger-pip-bend.intro: This is finger middle-joint bending for your {side} hand. Hold your {side} index finger steady just below its middle joint with your other hand. Bend only the middle joint as far as is comfortable, then straighten it slowly. Follow along with me.

hand-band-open.intro: This is hand opening against a rubber band, for your {side} hand. Put a rubber band around your fingers and thumb. Open your fingers wide against the band, hold briefly, then close slowly. Follow along with me.
